title: VenueOsmLayer
description: One city file of the OSM venue layer, odbl/<city>/venues-osm.geojson: a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Point features, one per hand-picked OpenStreetMap element (L and P tiers only). The layer is a derivative database of OpenStreetMap, published under the ODbL 1.0 in odbl/; this schema is Apache-2.0 like every schema here. Files are written by polis-internal scripts/extract_osm_venues.py and never edited by hand. Gameplay data joins to a feature by venue_id only (seeds/<world>/venues/*.yaml, venue.schema.json); no other file stores an OSM name, point or id. v0.1.0 (2026-10-10, VENUE-OSM-0).

license.description: SPDX id of the database licence. Contents are under DbCL 1.0 (odbl/LICENSE).

attribution.description: Attribution required by the ODbL. Must contain "© OpenStreetMap contributors".

geometry.description: Points only. Ways and relations are placed at their Overpass center; outlines are never published.

coordinates.description: [lon, lat], 7 decimal places as stored by OSM.

venue_id.description: Our id. Exactly one row in seeds/<world>/venues/ has this id, with name_source osm.

osm_version.description: Element version at extract time. Present on every feature of a live extract (Overpass `out meta`); absent on every feature of an extract built from saved responses without versions.

name.description: The OSM name tag, verbatim. null for an unnamed element; the game then shows a generic kind label. Never edited: a name that fails the safety checks drops the pick.

osm_tag.description: The key=value that says what the feature is, e.g. leisure=park.

retrieved_at.description: The Overpass osm_base timestamp the feature reflects.
